title: The Base of a Granite Ridge Restoration Charge Where the Pass Account Has Been Restored Before
content:
The base from which the charge for restoring scanning privileges on a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass is worked out is taken as follows.

**First.** Where the pass account carries at least as many refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date as the number of refusals the tier tolerates before privileges are reviewed, the base of the charge is the tier's reinstatement fee taken once for each refusal left uncured past its grace period.

**Second.** Where the pass account carries a charge already raised for restoring scanning privileges in this season and the refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date are fewer than the number the tier tolerates, the base of the charge is the tier's reinstatement fee taken once and a half, a multiple of 1.5.

**Otherwise.** In any other case the base is not multiplied by this rule.

### The two conditions

| Refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date | A charge already raised this season for restoring scanning privileges | The base of the charge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| at least the tier's tolerance | either | the reinstatement fee taken once for each refusal left uncured |
| below the tier's tolerance | yes | the reinstatement fee at a multiple of 1.5 |
| below the tier's tolerance | no | not multiplied by this rule |

The refusal count is read before the earlier restoration: where the tier's tolerance is reached, the base answers to the refusals left uncured whether or not the pass has been restored before this season.

### Worked on hypothetical figures

A Granite Ridge Summit Pass carries a reinstatement fee of 49.00 and tolerates 3 refusals.

Where the pass account carries 3 refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date and 2 refusals stand left uncured past their grace period, the base is 49.00 taken twice, which is 98.00.

Where the pass account carries 1 refusal in that window and one charge for restoring scanning privileges has already been raised this season, the base is 49.00 at a multiple of 1.5, which is 73.50.
